lanes.summary: I have thoroughly reviewed the provided diff against ticket PMAT-3477 ("0.68.2: ladder cpu-only rung"). The diff correctly and safely implements the logic to allow CPU-only rungs to skip the `capability_match` gate. Two comprehensive test cases are included which correctly verify both the green path (CPU-only rung correctly skips capability match) and the red path (GPU-claiming rung fails if capability match is skipped). The logic is mathematically sound, correctly avoids `KeyError` exceptions when parsing JSON responses, and properly normalizes the skipped state.
